title: 第一卷 第12章 没证据，算了？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

闫耀宗怀抱着傻婆娘，低声安慰着她。

看着被石头砸破的玻璃窗，还有地上三四十块石头，闫耀宗眼神冰冷，涌动着凶戾。

傻婆娘居然在闫耀宗怀里睡着了。

闫耀宗抱着她，小心翼翼走到两张办公桌拼凑的‘床’边，将她放到‘床’上，然后轻手轻脚地开始收拾房间内的石子跟碎玻璃。

“耀宗！”

就在这时候，闫振东的声音，从小房间门口响起。

闫耀宗抬头看去，只见他穿着蓑衣，手里边拿着用油布盖着的挂篮。

“草，这是怎么了？”闫振东脸色难看，快步走进小房间。

“小声点！”闫耀宗剑眉一挑，道：“出去说！”

“哦哦！”闫振东也看到躺在两张办公桌上，陷入熟睡的傻婆娘，连忙压低声音。

闫耀宗大步向着小房间外走去。

“你怎么来了？”闫耀宗问道。

“我娘让我来给你们送些晚饭！”闫振东提起手里边被油布盖着的挂篮，继续道，“耀宗，里边是什么情况？”

“你不是都看到了嘛？”闫耀宗懒得跟闫振东废话，伸手拿过他手里边提着的挂篮，向着小房间内走去。

把挂篮放到办公桌下边，闫耀宗看了一眼，即便在熟睡中，依然皱着柳眉的傻婆娘，眼中戾气更浓。

没有吵醒傻婆娘，闫耀宗再次向着小房间外走去。

“耀宗，知道是谁干的不？”闫振东目露愤怒。

闫耀宗没吭声，逃出裤袋里的香烟，抽出两根，递给闫振东一根。

点燃香烟。

闫耀宗深吸一口气，道：“不知道！”

瞧着面无表情，抽着闷烟的闫耀宗，闫振东咬着牙，道：“会不会是闫忠国？这王八蛋之前刚跟你闹了矛盾。”

“没证据，别乱猜！”闫耀宗道。

“耀宗，这事情，还要什么证据啊？除了他，我想不出还会是谁。要不，咱俩去他家，把他抓起来，先揍一顿再说！”

闫耀宗摇摇头，道：“我说了，没证据，别乱猜！行了，你先回去，这事情就算了！”

“算了？”闫振东满脸难以置信的看着闫耀宗，焦急道，“耀宗，这事情怎么能算了啊？你越这样，别人就越得寸进尺。你能算，我算不了，我现在就去找闫忠国！”

“啪！”

闫耀宗右手一抬，按住准备转身的闫振东肩膀，道：“振东，听我的，这事情，到此为止。你先回去吧，我还要收拾房间！”

“闫耀宗，你特娘的还有没有点血性了？这种事情都能忍？草，老子看错你了！”闫振东脸一黑，满眼失望地盯着闫耀宗。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yan Yaozong held the silly woman in his arms and comforted her in a low voice.

Looking at the glass windows smashed by stones and the thirty or forty stones on the ground, Yan Yaozong's eyes were cold and filled with ferocity.

The silly woman actually fell asleep in Yan Yaozong's arms.

Yan Yaozong held her in his arms, carefully walked to the bed made up of two desks, put her on the bed, and then gently began to clean up the stones and broken glass in the room.

"Yao Zong!"

At this moment, Yan Zhendong's voice sounded from the door of the small room.

Yan Yaozong looked up and saw that he was wearing a raincoat and holding a hanging basket covered with oilcloth in his hand.

"Hey, what's going on?" Yan Zhendong looked ugly and walked into the small room quickly.

"Keep your voice down!" Yan Yaozong raised his eyebrows and said, "Go out and talk!"

"Oh!" Yan Zhendong also saw the silly woman lying on the two desks and falling asleep, and quickly lowered his voice.

Yan Yaozong strode out of the small room.

"Why are you here?" Yan Yaozong asked.

"My mother asked me to bring you some dinner!" Yan Zhendong raised the hanging basket covered with oilcloth in his hand and continued, "Yao Zong, what's going on inside?"

"Didn't you see everything?" Yan Yaozong was too lazy to talk nonsense to Yan Zhendong. He reached for the hanging basket in his hand and walked towards the small room.

Putting the hanging basket under the desk, Yan Yaozong took a look at the silly woman who was still frowning even though she was sleeping soundly, and her eyes were even more fierce.

Without waking up the stupid woman, Yan Yaozong walked out of the small room again.

"Yao Zong, do you know who did this?" Yan Zhendong looked angry.

Yan Yaozong said nothing, took out the cigarettes from his trouser pocket, pulled out two cigarettes, and handed one to Yan Zhendong.

Light a cigarette.

Yan Yaozong took a deep breath and said, "I don't know!"

Looking at Yan Yaozong who was expressionless and smoking a cigarette, Yan Zhendong gritted his teeth and said, "Could it be Yan Zhongguo? This bastard just had a conflict with you before."

"There is no evidence, so don't make random guesses!" Yan Yaozong said.

"Yao Zong, what kind of evidence do you need for this matter? I can't think of anyone other than him. Otherwise, let's go to his house, arrest him, and beat him up first!"

Yan Yaozong shook his head and said, "I said, don't make random guesses if there is no evidence! Okay, you go back first and forget about it!"

"Forget it?" Yan Zhendong looked at Yan Yaozong with disbelief, and said anxiously, "Yao Zong, how can we forget this matter? The more you do this, the more others will take advantage of it. You can calculate it, but I can't. I'm going to find Yan Zhongguo now!"

"Crack!"

Yan Yaozong raised his right hand, held the shoulder of Yan Zhendong who was about to turn around, and said: "Zhendong, listen to me, this matter ends here. You go back first, I have to clean up the room!"

"Yan Yaozong, do you have any blood in you? Can you tolerate this kind of thing? Damn, I misjudged you!" Yan Zhendong's face darkened, and he stared at Yan Yaozong with disappointment.
